meta_description: LDC Plumbing and Heating in Stoke-on-Trent. Emergency repairs, boiler installations, and heating maintenance. Fast response, fair prices. Call now.
hero_eyebrow: Gas Safe Registered — Emergency Callouts Available
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or broken boiler? We arrive fast and fix it right. Same-day repairs, 24/7 emergencies.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Stoke-on-Trent
services_subhead: From emergency burst pipes to full heating system overhauls, we handle every job with speed and care.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast, any time of day or night. We carry parts on the van to get you sorted without delay.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: New condensing boilers installed to save you money on energy bills. Full system checks and commission included, with 10-year warranty options.

services.title: Boiler Servicing & Repairs
services.desc: Annual servicing keeps your boiler efficient and safe. Breakdowns diagnosed and repaired same day, with transparent pricing.

services.title: Central Heating System Upgrades
services.desc: Radiator replacements, power flush cleaning, and thermostatic controls installed to improve comfort and cut heating costs.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: Tap installations, new pipework, and relocations for renovations. We work neatly and finish on time, with all work guaranteed.

services.title: Pipework & Leak Detection
services.desc: Water leaks traced and repaired without unnecessary excavation. We use modern detection equipment to pinpoint problems accurately.

about_pullquote: I started this business to give Stoke families honest, reliable plumbing at fair prices.
about_para_1: LDC Plumbing and Heating has been serving Stoke-on-Trent and the surrounding areas for over 15 years. Founded on the principle that every customer deserves straightforward advice and skilled workmanship, we've built our reputation by turning up on time, fixing the problem right, and treating your home with respect.
about_para_2: We're Gas Safe Registered and fully insured, with a track record of over 2,000 completed jobs. Our customers return to us because we don't overcharge, we explain what we're doing, and we stand behind our work. Whether it's an emergency at midnight or a planned boiler upgrade, you'll get the same professional service.
reviews_heading: What Stoke-on-Trent Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with a burst pipe the day before Christmas. Called LDC and they came out within the hour. Fixed it properly, no messy patches, and charged exactly what they quoted. Absolute lifesaver. Can't praise them enough.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: New boiler installation was smooth and hassle-free. The lad explained everything as he went along, cleaned up after himself, and even showed me how to use the new controls. Great job, very fair price. Saving a fortune on heating already.
reviews.author: Janet P.

reviews.text: Been using LDC for years now. They do my annual boiler service without fail, always professional, never overcharge. You know you're in good hands. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a proper plumber.
reviews.author: David M.
